size_basis: study default envelope box, read back from the cad/stl registry (M0 study envelope; design sizing per the duty sheet follows)

machine.type: two-high cold rolling mill per the duty sheet and the AQS-MFG-010 tool row (Table 2.1, rev C metering split): bedplate, two vertical housings (40 x 360, study) with crown tie, upper/lower work rolls OD 120 x 300 (5 mm gap at the strip class), journals, screw-down studs, entry/exit strip tables on the pass line, drive gearbox and motor as purchased envelopes, control cabinet as a purchased envelope; roll-zone guard rail (A-MACH) + hold-down frame
machine.tool_row: AQS-MFG-010 Table 2.1: Two-high cold rolling mill, nameplate 2.2 kW; energy basis 250 MPa x strain 2.3 / 0.55 (DIETER1988) = 0.0324 kWh/kg + no-load 15 % x 1 h (A-M-177)

pass_line.basis: roll centres are study values; the strip pass line is the layout choice (WORK_ORDER W12)

machine.material: 316L where the stream is wet (duty section 3); the mill is a dry forming machine - no wetted stream on the graph; CA 0 mm
machine.purchased: drive gearbox + motor (2.2 kW nameplate, AQS-MFG-010) and control cabinet per plan rule 6, ratings from the node
machine.guard: four-post hold-down/guard frame pins the registry box (X-PAR-04); roll-zone guard rail on 4 posts x 3 tiers; 8 slab anchors (fasteners.csv)
machine.study_dims: housing, roll and table dimensions are study values sized to the strip class (WORK_ORDER W12)

N3.note: drain flush at the envelope bottom; 50 datum is the schedule placeholder

N4.note: vent flush at the envelope top; the 800 datum is the box top

N5.note: vent flush at the envelope top; the 800 datum is the box top
